locator.section: RG115d; complete supplied conclusion w025–w040 and Amen w041 only; accented common words and terminal; proper body excluded

entries.claim: This setting’s RG115d supplies the complete Son-directed Qui vivis ending w025–w040 and Amen w041, excluding the proper body. The literal rubric list is unaccented. The matching common words on p.123 and terminal on p.226 control selected stress; p.226 also distinguishes the Amen response period. These controls do not establish response actors, singing or the distribution of conclusions in grouped orations.
